motifs.name: opponent_cramped_interior_group
motifs.description: The evaluated side has a large interior opponent group with very few liberties surrounded by the evaluated side’s stones, indicating the opponent is trapped and dying.

motifs.name: our_safe_3plus_liberty_groups_vs_opponent_single_liberty_dead
motifs.description: The evaluated side has at least 6 groups with 3 or more liberties (safe), while the opponent has at least 2 groups with exactly 1 liberty (dead), indicating a large life-and-death imbalance favoring the evaluated side.

motifs.name: third_fourth_line_dominance
motifs.description: The evaluated side has many more stones on the 3rd and 4th lines from the edge than on the 1st and 2nd lines, indicating strong outward influence and territory potential.

motifs.name: our_anchored_groups_vs_opponent_floating
motifs.description: The evaluated side has at least 4 groups with 3+ liberties touching lines 1-3 (anchored), while opponent has at least 2 central groups (no stone below row 3 or above row 15) with at most 2 liberties, indicating territorial security against weak floating opponent.

motifs.name: our_large_stable_groups_vs_opponent_small_weak_groups
motifs.description: The evaluated side has at least one group of 10+ stones with 5+ liberties (large and stable), while the opponent has at least 3 groups of 2-5 stones with at most 2 liberties (small and weak), indicating a strong territorial foundation against crumbling opposition.

metadata.score_definition: P(motif=True | winning) - P(motif=True | losing), preserved from the canonical discovery ranking.
